g.text: Safe under these rules. Not worth launching on these numbers.
First Light, 5 Nov 2026. Hourly NEAR from 12 Aug 2025, open $4.04. One path, not a forecast.
Six borrowers hit the $50K cap. Collateral could support about $717K. Demand did not run out. The cap did. Points are thin against Rhea. One liquidation, day 84. Reserve unused.
User choice: native NEAR, first 90 days, $100K plus optional $100K, $1M friendly liquidity. Bull window was offered and not chosen.
